theorem T01 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeTr N M = m.trJ * M - (m.Du + m.Dv) * N := by
  intro m N M
  unfold Scope.Model.modeTr Scope.Model.trJ
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeTr N M = m.trJ * M - (m.Du + m.Dv) * N

author: private-claude
name: T05
source:
theorem T05 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → 0 < m.modeDet N M := by
  intro m N M hd hM hN hS hDD
  have key : m.modeDet N M = m.detJ * (M * M) - m.S * M * N + m.Du * m.Dv * (N * N) := by
    unfold Scope.Model.modeDet Scope.Model.detJ Scope.Model.S
    grind
  have h1 : 0 ≤ (m.Du * m.Dv * N - m.S * M) * N := Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) hN
  have h2 : 0 < m.detJ * (M * M) := Int.mul_pos hd (Int.mul_pos hM hM)
  have h3 : (m.Du * m.Dv * N - m.S * M) * N = m.Du * m.Dv * (N * N) - m.S * M * N := by
    grind
  rw [key]
  omega
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → 0 < m.modeDet N M

author: private-claude
name: T06
source:
theorem T06 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.Du * m.Dv * N < m.S * M := by
  intro m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro h
  have h6 := T05 m N M h1 h2 h3 (Int.not_lt.mp h) h4
  exact Int.lt_asymm h5 h6
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.Du * m.Dv * N < m.S * M

author: private-claude
name: T07
source:
theorem T07 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.S * p ^ 2 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 → ∀ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n → 0 ≤ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) := by
  intro m p s hd hp hD hS n hn
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro h
  have hlt : m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) < 0 := by omega
  have hM : 0 < Scope.modeM p := by
    have := Int.mul_pos hp hp
    unfold Scope.modeM
    grind
  have hN : 0 ≤ Scope.modeN s n := by
    unfold Scope.modeN
    exact Int.mul_nonneg (Int.sq_nonneg _) (Int.sq_nonneg _)
  have h2 := T06 m _ _ hd hM hN hD hlt
  have hn1 : (1:Int) ≤ (n:Int) := by omega
  have h1 : (1:Int) ≤ (n:Int)^2 := by
    have := Int.mul_le_mul hn1 hn1 (by omega) (by omega)
    grind
  have h3 := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (Int.sq_nonneg s)
  have h4 : s^2 ≤ Scope.modeN s n := by
    unfold Scope.modeN
    grind
  have h5 := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h4 hD
  have h6 : m.S * Scope.modeM p ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s^2 := by
    unfold Scope.modeM
    exact hS
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.S * p ^ 2 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 → ∀ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n → 0 ≤ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p)

author: private-claude
name: sq_nn_aux
source:
theorem sq_nn_aux : ∀ x : Int, 0 ≤ x * x := by
  intro x
  cases Int.le_total 0 x with
  | inl h => exact Int.mul_nonneg h h
  | inr h =>
    have h1 : 0 ≤ (-x) * (-x) := Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) (by omega)
    rw [Int.neg_mul_neg] at h1
    exact h1

author: private-claude
name: T09
source:
theorem T09 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S ∧ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ < m.S ^ 2 := by
  intro m N M hP hDu hDv hM hN hmd
  have hQ : 0 < m.Du * m.Dv := Int.mul_pos hDu hDv
  have h6 := T06 m N M hP hM hN (Int.le_of_lt hQ) hmd
  have hQN : 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N := Int.mul_nonneg (Int.le_of_lt hQ) hN
  have hSpos : 0 < m.S := by
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro h'
    have h1 : 0 ≤ (-m.S) * M := Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) (Int.le_of_lt hM)
    grind
  refine ⟨hSpos, ?_⟩
  have key : m.detJ * (M*M) + m.Du * m.Dv * (N*N) < m.S * N * M := by
    unfold Scope.Model.modeDet at hmd
    unfold Scope.Model.detJ Scope.Model.S
    grind
  have hMM : 0 < M * M := Int.mul_pos hM hM
  have hNpos : 0 < N := by
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro h'
    have h0 : N = 0 := by omega
    subst h0
    have := Int.mul_pos hP hMM
    grind
  have hNN : 0 < N * N := Int.mul_pos hNpos hNpos
  have hA : 0 < m.detJ * (M*M) := Int.mul_pos hP hMM
  have hB : 0 < m.Du * m.Dv * (N*N) := Int.mul_pos hQ hNN
  have hsq := Int.mul_self_lt_mul_self (by omega : 0 ≤ m.detJ * (M*M) + m.Du * m.Dv * (N*N)) key
  have hd := sq_nn_aux (m.detJ * (M*M) - m.Du * m.Dv * (N*N))
  have ht : 0 ≤ (N*M)*(N*M) := sq_nn_aux _
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro h'
  have h2 : m.S ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ := by omega
  have h3 := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 ht
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S ∧ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ < m.S ^ 2

author: private-claude
name: T10
source:
theorem T10 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.detJ * M < m.S * N := by
  intro m N M hM hN hD hneg
  have key : m.modeDet N M = m.detJ*M*M - m.S*N*M + N*N*(m.Du*m.Dv) := by
    unfold Scope.Model.modeDet Scope.Model.detJ Scope.Model.S
    grind
  have h1 : 0 ≤ N*N*(m.Du*m.Dv) := Int.mul_nonneg (sq_nn_aux N) hD
  have hlt : (m.detJ*M - m.S*N)*M < 0 := by
    have e : (m.detJ*M - m.S*N)*M = m.detJ*M*M - m.S*N*M := by grind
    rw [e]
    omega
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro h
  have h2 : 0 ≤ m.detJ*M - m.S*N := by omega
  have h3 := Int.mul_nonneg h2 (Int.le_of_lt hM)
  exact Int.not_lt.mpr h3 hlt
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.detJ * M < m.S * N
